fact: The Justice Ministry's legal undersecretary says it is preparing, with the digital transformation ministry, a draft 2026 law regulating data and artificial intelligence.

A November 2025 decree established the Sudanese Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority and the Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority, though neither had issued binding rules as of mid-2026, per the SCPS article citing the AI Regulation Tracker.
